profile.headline: Senior Lead Frontend Developer at CooperVision
profile.summary: Highly competent, results-driven certified front-end engineer with diverse information technology experience and a focus on building performant, well-executed, user centric interfaces for web and mobile applications. Motivated creative professional with experience leveraging HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build responsive websites, mobile apps, and interactive features that drive business growth and improve user experience. Excels at leveraging new and existing technology and knowledge to provide value and ensure company growth.

positions.title: Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
Participated in the architecture, development, testing, and deployment for several multi-regional projects for over 3 currently supported SaaS AngularJs and VueJs applications.
Implemented and designed the UI framework used in current applications by delivering high quality screens based on UX wireframes.
Worked directly with project managers and UX designer from a technical standpoint to meet client requirements and provide innovative project solutions. 
Own front-end project requirements and architected solutions that met business requirements that resulted in client satisfaction.
Monitored user workflows to continuously improve performance metrics and provide support for existing projects.
Helped to continuously improve development work in all areas (coding, processes, tools, testing, etc.).

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Led front-end development on agency projects implemented a variety of client websites after UX designer handoff that included: static sites, proprietary CMS solutions, Wordpress, Magento, Ektron, Joomla, Drupal, Sitecore and Progressive Web Applications.
Leveraged Magento to develop and maintain critical components of an e-commerce website, including shopping cart, quick view, and checkout pages.
Built single-page applications with JavaScript on a custom-built framework and Polymer to achieve top scores on load time performance.
Increased web traffic by improving navigation, creating dynamic media sections, introducing virtual tours and adding social media plugins.
Supported post-launch deliverables like client training for orientation on new platforms, SEO optimizations, and increasing performance metrics.

positions.title: Program Facilitator/Instructor
positions.description:
Responsible for providing a simulated real-world team environment to teach processes and teamwork skills to bootcamp students.
Project managed a small team of new developers using agile principles to implement a real-world nonprofit project based on stakeholder requirements.
Led meetings with stakeholders on project scope and features as acting technical lead.
Handled multiple priorities and tasks to built a full-scale Ionic mobile application with working backend API endpoint (MongoDB & Loopback) and front-end using Ionic which was deployed on Heroku.
Effectively organized and prioritized several projects at a time requiring detailed organization with no supervision resulting in the completion of 3 real-world projects.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Introduced wireframing and information architecture concepts to increase team productivity.
Maintained current client relationships by processing incoming requests.
Managed incoming proposals for work changes on a variety of Wordpress projects.
Completed UI implementation and coding under the supervision of the CEO.
Respond to client and prospect needs and requests in a courteous and knowledgeable manner.

positions.title: Assistant to Manager of Web Communications
positions.description:
Assisted Manager of Web communications update and post new content on their website.
Created and reviewed copy from the content manager for approval to be put on the website.
Designed processes for website clean-up and implemented performance improvements.
